title: Profound economic transformation
summary:
Main
By Michalis Voutsinas
Throughout history, periods of profound economic transformation have rarely been defined solely by faster growth or larger industrial output. More often, they have been characterised by a gradual but decisive reshaping of the geography of commerce. As industries evolve, supply chains adjust, technologies advance and competitive advantages shift between regions, global trade patterns are continuously rewritten.
